question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Magnificent
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ** **The word '**Magnificent' **means extremely beautiful, elaborate, or impressive.(शानदार)

 
 
• **Example- I**t was a **magnificent** shot, worthy of someone ranked higher than 56th in the world.
 
 
 
• ''**Splendid**''- magnificent; very impressive.(उत्कृष्ट)
 
 
• **Example- **There was a splendid palace in the center of the city.
 
 
 
• Here we can infer that the synonym of '**Magnificent**' is '**Splendid**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Splendid**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Here are other options explained along with their Hindi meaning and example sentences.

 
• **Humble(**विनम्र)**: **Having or showing a modest or low estimate of one's importance.

 
 
• **Example- **She is much too **humble **about her achievements.
 
 
 
• **Modest(**आडंबरहीन):** **unassuming in the estimation of one's abilities or achievements.
 
 
• **Example- **He was a very **modest **man, refusing to take any credit for the enterprise.
 
 
 
• **Regular(**नियमित)**: **recurring at uniform intervals.
 
 
• **Example- **Ram has a regular job now, making him the busiest lad in his friend's circle.
